name: Maps and Runes
summary: In Silverpine, maps and runes reveal Dalaran's interest in Ambermill. Horde agents recover a hidden crate for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

sections.title: A Hidden Cargo
sections.body: Horde agents find a Dalaran crate hidden along the border routes near Ambermill. Detailed regional charts and a rune-inscribed pendant lie inside. Human sentries stand nearby, so the scouts retrieve the artifact carefully. Dalaran's arcane reach lies close to their borders.

sections.title: Whispers at the Sepulcher
sections.body: At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister receives the recovered pendant. The Forsaken leadership sees that the Kirin Tor are working in Ambermill, but their purpose remains unclear. Allister cannot decipher the potent sorcery woven into the runes. He seeks undead arcane experts to uncover Dalaran's plot.

faq.q: What is inside the Dalaran crate?
faq.answer: The Dalaran crate holds detailed regional charts and a strange rune-inscribed pendant. Together, they suggest Dalaran is planning around Ambermill.

Shadow Priest Allister is a prominent Forsaken authority stationed at the Sepulcher. He oversees local intelligence gathering and coordinates defenses against hostile human remnants and Kirin Tor operatives in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken concerned about Dalaran in Ambermill?
faq.answer: The Forsaken fear Dalaran's presence in Ambermill, on the border of lands in Lordaeron they claim. Arcane relics or secret troop movements could threaten the Undercity's hold over Silverpine.

faq.q: Can Shadow Priest Allister decipher the pendant?
faq.answer: No. Allister recognizes Dalaran sorcery on the pendant, but its enchantments elude his priestly craft. He seeks deeper arcane knowledge.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: The investigation continues with Dalar's Analysis. The pendant goes to Dalar Dawnweaver, an arcane specialist at the Sepulcher who can break down Kirin Tor magic.

faq.q: What quest leads up to Maps and Runes?
faq.answer: Border Crossings leads into Maps and Runes. There, the Forsaken assign an operative to inspect suspicious trade crates moving into Silverpine from Dalaran's borders.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know Dalaran's surviving wizards keep outposts close to Undercity territory. Recovering their enchanted talismans helps safeguard Forsaken sovereignty in Silverpine.
As a Mage, you know the rune-inscribed pendant bears patterns of Kirin Tor enchantment, shaped by Dalaran's tradition of shielding and arcane warding.
As a Priest, you know even Shadow Priest Allister's formidable shadow magic cannot unravel the intricate arcane formulas carved into the pendant.
As a member of the Horde, you know securing Silverpine Forest from Alliance-aligned forces like the Kirin Tor protects a vital supply corridor across northern Lordaeron.
